description: Implementation of InterestPauseWritePlatformService for managing interest pause variations on loans, including creation, update, deletion, and validation logic.

classes.name: InterestPauseWritePlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing interest pause management logic for loans, including creation, update, deletion, and validation of interest pause variations.

methods.name: createInterestPause
methods.description: Creates a new interest pause variation for a loan identified by ExternalId or loanId, with specified start and end dates.

methods.name: deleteInterestPause
methods.description: Deletes an existing interest pause variation for a loan identified by ExternalId or loanId.

methods.name: updateInterestPause
methods.description: Updates an existing interest pause variation with new start and end dates.

methods.name: processDeleteInterestPause
methods.description: Internal method to handle deletion logic, including validation and repository operations.

methods.name: processUpdateInterestPause
methods.description: Internal method to handle update logic, including validation and repository operations.

methods.name: processInterestPause
methods.description: Internal method to create and save a new interest pause variation, then reprocess transactions.

methods.name: validateInterestPauseDates
methods.description: Validates that interest pause dates are within loan start and maturity dates, do not overlap, and meet other business rules.

methods.name: validateActiveLoan
methods.description: Checks if the loan is active before performing interest pause operations.

methods.name: parseDate
methods.description: Parses a date string into LocalDate using specified format and locale, throws exception if invalid.
